title: Migo Android C ABI package manifest v1
description: Describes one shipped Android C ABI package slice, one Android ABI. The primary artifact is a static library the host links into its own .so; every field is a claim scripts/test-android-sdk-contract.sh checks against the staged package.

abi.description: Userspace ABI. Android is a Linux kernel with a Bionic userspace; a static library built here cannot be linked into a glibc or OpenHarmony consumer.

android_abi.description: The Android ABI directory name, distinct from arch (arm64-v8a vs aarch64).

min_android_api.description: Minimum Android API. Pinned to the project floor; raising it is a support contract change.

link_libraries.description: The -l flags the consumer must add when linking the static archive into its own .so. A static archive has no DT_NEEDED, so the transitive system libraries are the consumer's to provide. Sorted and unique.

snapshot_policy.description: Android always embeds a startup snapshot; 'none' is a Linux-only policy. Must agree with the snapshots array.

v8.description: Provenance of the V8 this package was cross-compiled against, copied from the V8 component manifest. Its target must equal this package's target_triple: a V8 built for another arch cannot be mixed in.

artifacts.description: Shipped file names mapped to their size in bytes; the static library must be present.
